mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, title, description, source, item_kind, category_id, priority, status, expect_date, accept_text, version_id, review_note, wsjf_business, wsjf_urgency, wsjf_risk, wsjf_effort, created_by, created_at, updated_at

d.id, d.workspace_id, d.req_id, d.title, d.description, d.source, d.item_kind, d.category_id, d.priority, d.status, d.expect_date, d.accept_text, d.version_id, v.name AS versionName, d.review_note, d.wsjf_business, d.wsjf_urgency, d.wsjf_risk, d.wsjf_effort, d.created_by, d.created_at, d.updated_at

choose.when: ORDER BY FIELD(d.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), d.created_at DESC, d.id
ORDER BY d.expect_date IS NULL, d.expect_date, d.created_at DESC, d.id
ORDER BY (d.wsjf_business + d.wsjf_urgency + d.wsjf_risk) * 10 / d.wsjf_effort IS NULL, (d.wsjf_business + d.wsjf_urgency + d.wsjf_risk) * 10 / d.wsjf_effort DESC, d.id
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY FIELD(d.status, 'review', 'pass', 'plan', 'rej'), FIELD(d.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), d.created_at DESC, d.id

mapper.select:
SELECT d.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demand d
GROUP BY d.status

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.status = #{status}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = d.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
SELECT FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId} AND status <> 'rej' ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'plan', 'pass', 'review'), created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand (id, workspace_id, req_id, title, description, source, item_kind, category_id, priority, status, expect_date, accept_text, version_id, review_note, wsjf_business, wsjf_urgency, wsjf_risk, wsjf_effort, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{source}, #{itemKind}, #{categoryId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{expectDate}, #{acceptText}, #{versionId}, #{reviewNote}, #{wsjfBusiness}, #{wsjfUrgency}, #{wsjfRisk}, #{wsjfEffort}, #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE demand SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, source = #{source}, item_kind = #{itemKind}, category_id = #{categoryId}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, expect_date = #{expectDate}, accept_text = #{acceptText}, version_id = #{versionId}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, wsjf_business = #{wsjfBusiness}, wsjf_urgency = #{wsjfUrgency}, wsjf_risk = #{wsjfRisk}, wsjf_effort = #{wsjfEffort}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM demand WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
DELETE FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_log (workspace_id, demand_id, action, note, operator) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{demandId}, #{action}, #{note}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT dl.id, dl.demand_id AS demandId, dl.action, dl.note, dl.operator, u.display_name AS operatorName, dl.created_at AS createdAt FROM demand_log dl LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = dl.operator WHERE dl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dl.demand_id = #{demandId} ORDER BY dl.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}

SELECT demand_id AS demandId, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'pass' THEN created_at END) AS passAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'rej' THEN created_at END) AS rejAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'plan' THEN created_at END) AS planAt FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY demand_id

SELECT l.demand_id AS demandId, COUNT(*) AS docCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rd.published_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS docPublished, MIN(rd.created_at) AS docStart, MAX(rd.published_at) AS docEnd FROM demand_doc_link l INNER JOIN requirement_doc rd ON rd.id = l.doc_id AND rd.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.demand_id IN #{id}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = rd.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = rd.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
AND (rd.published_at IS NOT NULL OR rd.owner_user_id = #{userId})
GROUP BY l.demand_id

SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, COUNT(*) AS taskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taskDone, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column <> 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taskOpen, MIN(CASE WHEN t.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN t.start_date WHEN t.board_column <> 'backlog' THEN DATE(t.created_at) END) AS devStart, MAX(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN COALESCE(t.completed_at, DATE(t.updated_at)) END) AS devEnd FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY t.demand_id

SELECT x.demandId AS demandId, COUNT(*) AS caseCount, MIN(x.firstAt) AS testStart, MAX(x.lastAt) AS testEnd, SUM(CASE WHEN x.lastStatus IS NULL OR x.lastStatus <> 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testPending FROM ( SELECT tc.demand_id AS demandId, tc.id AS caseId, MIN(r.created_at) AS firstAt, MAX(r.created_at) AS lastAt, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(r.status ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC), ',', 1) AS lastStatus FROM test_case tc LEFT JOIN test_case_run r ON r.case_id = tc.id AND r.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tc.demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY tc.demand_id, tc.id ) x GROUP BY x.demandId
mapper.update: UPDATE demand SET version_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE demand SET version_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
